header.eyebrow: Since the early days of the web
header.title: A pioneer with focus on the <highlight>human side</highlight>
header.description: I act as the strategic bridge between complex technology, politically governed organizations, and the actual needs of end users.

journey.title: From Perl to Next.js and mobile IT projects
journey.paragraph1: I began my journey in the early days of the web, when I coded in Perl, C++ and Java, designed databases, and learned SQL. This deep technical foundation has given me a unique understanding of how systems actually work under the hood, long before today’s modern frameworks existed.
journey.paragraph2: I have experience from large companies, the public sector and smaller family-owned businesses. As a project manager, I helped lead mobile IT projects. Through work with procurement, EU projects and environmental initiatives, I gained deep insight into the processes and requirements that shape large, socially important organizations.
journey.paragraph3: As a former higher vocational education teacher and system owner for media houses, my greatest strength is the ability to be pedagogical and social – making the complex understandable.

public.title: Public sector expertise

tech.title: Technical pioneer
